in_hindi.name: युवंक
in_hindi.meaning: युवा (yuvā) + नक (nak) = युवा (yuvā) + रक्षक (rakṣak) = युवा रक्षक (yuvā rakṣak) = youthful protector

in_tamil.name: யுவங்க
in_tamil.meaning: யுவம் (yuvam) + ங்க (ṅg) = யுவத்தில் கையல்விருந்து (yuvattil kaivalvirundhu) = one who protects the youth

in_marathi.name: Yuvank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Youth, Energy, Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yuvank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yuvank is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'yuva' (youth) and 'ank' (energy or power). In Hindu mythology, Yuvank represents the energy and power of youth, and is often associated with the divine god Krishna, who embodies the eternal youth and joy of life.
